title: WPU Enterprise Information System
summary: A 2026 team project for enrolment, admission, and dormitory management.
description:
A full-stack enrolment, admission, and dormitory system built with a team for IS403 in 2026. The published project note records Clyde's contribution as the dormitory subsystem.

The recorded stack is React, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and Docker. No public project URL or repository URL was recorded with the source note.
